spec.name: GoldRSIMomentumSessionTrend
spec.hypothesis: XAUUSD exhibits persistent intraday momentum during London and New York sessions due to institutional order flow clustering around session opens and macroeconomic releases. Retail traders often fade early moves or chase late breakouts, creating a statistical edge for systematic trend-following entries on confirmed RSI momentum shifts within active sessions. The losing side consists of discretionary mean-reversion traders and breakout chasers entering after exhaustion.
spec.entry_logic: Enter long when RSI crosses above 50 from below AND price is above EMA(21) AND current bar is within London or NY session. Enter short when RSI crosses below 50 from above AND price is below EMA(21) AND within session. Requires prior bar RSI on opposite side of 50 to confirm crossover.
spec.exit_logic: Stop loss set at max(5.0, ATR(14) * sl_mult) USD points from entry. Take profit at max(1.5, ATR(14) * tp_mult) USD points. Both distances are positive and validated against NaN/zero ATR.
filters: Active only during London or NY session
spec.expected_failure_conditions: Extended Asian-session-dominated low-volatility regimes or central bank intervention causing non-trending RSI oscillations around 50 without directional follow-through.

details.detail: Bit-identical signal tapes produced on two independent runs with seed=42.
Verified signal identity T_c[0..c] == T_full[0..c] across 20 cut points (tolerance 1e-9).
